method: Full-field editions 2022-2025 with course coordinates; nearest NCEI ISD station <=25 km active for the dates; 07-19 local (solar offset) FM-15 observations; round field scoring demeaned within each edition. Correlation and descriptive splits only; no causal claims.
causal_claims: none (observational, confounded by tee waves, course setup, field strength and station distance)
